attempts.summary: Configured node2 on VLAN 10 and node3 on VLAN 20 over the shared link (node1's eth1 / node2 & node3's enp8s0), with node1 (VyOS) as router-on-a-stick using 802.1q sub-interfaces eth1.10 (10.10.10.1/24) and eth1.20 (10.10.20.1/24), plus a forward-filter firewall permitting inter-VLAN traffic. node2 got enp8s0.10 (10.10.10.2/24) via NetworkManager VLAN connection with a static route to 10.10.20.0/24 via 10.10.10.1; node3 got enp8s0.20 (10.10.20.2/24) with a static route to 10.10.10.0/24 via 10.10.20.1. Verified end-to-end reachability and confirmed via tcpdump that traffic is tagged 802.1Q vlan 10/20 on the shared link and routed by node1. All three nodes were then sequentially rebooted (one at a time, config persisted across reboot), each confirmed via changed /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id, with full VLAN config and cross-VLAN connectivity re-verified after each restart.
